title: Kurta Neckline Guide: Which Neck Design Suits Your Face and Body
excerpt: Round, V, band collar, notched, sweetheart or keyhole? Our kurta neckline guide shows which neck design flatters your face shape and body type.
body:
The most flattering kurta neckline is the one that balances your face shape and frames your shoulders. Round faces look best in V and notched necks, long faces suit round and boat shapes, and almost everyone looks lovely in a soft sweetheart. Here is a clear guide to every common kurta neckline and who it suits best.

## Why the neckline matters so much

The neckline sits right next to your face, so it is the first thing people notice. It can make your neck look longer, your shoulders look broader or narrower, and your face look softer or sharper. When you are buying online from abroad and cannot try things on, knowing your best neckline saves a lot of guesswork.

## The six most common kurta necklines

| Neckline | What it looks like | Best for face shape | Best for body type |
|---|---|---|---|
| Round | A simple curve at the base of the neck | Long, oval, angular | Narrow shoulders, slim frames |
| V-neck | Two lines meeting in a point | Round, square, full | Fuller bust, short neck |
| Band collar | A short stand-up collar, like a Mandarin | Oval, heart, long | Slim frames, long necks |
| Notched | A round or band neck with a small slit in front | Round, oval, square | Most body types |
| Sweetheart | A curved neckline shaped like the top of a heart | Oval, round, heart | Smaller bust, balanced frames |
| Keyhole | A small opening at the front or back, often with a tie | Oval, long | Most body types |

## Neckline by neckline

### Round neck

The round neck is a timeless everyday choice. It softens angular faces and adds width to a narrow frame. If you have a long face or a long neck, a round neck is especially flattering. If your face is very round, choose a slightly deeper round neck rather than a high one so the face is not boxed in. Round necks also show off a pretty embroidered yoke beautifully, and the [Coral Pink Hand Block Print Cotton Tunic Top](/products/coral-pink-hand-block-print-cotton-tunic-top/) is an easy example for daily wear.

### V-neck and notched neck

A V-neck draws the eye downwards, which creates the look of a longer neck and a slimmer face. It is the go-to neckline for round and square faces and for women with a fuller bust, because it breaks up the area across the chest.

A notched neck gives a similar lengthening effect but is more modest. It is often the best compromise for office wear or temple visits. The [Off-White Embroidered Cotton Kurta Set](/products/off-white-embroidered-cotton-flex-kurta-pant-organza-dupatta-set/) shows how a neat front neckline with embroidery looks elegant without being formal.

### Band collar

The band collar, also called a Chinese or Mandarin collar, looks crisp and modern. It suits oval and heart faces and women with a longer neck. If your neck is short or your face is round, a high band collar can make the area look crowded; ask for a slightly lower band or a collar with a front slit, which combines the polish of a collar with the lengthening line of a notch.

### Sweetheart and keyhole

The sweetheart neckline is feminine and festive. Its curves soften strong jawlines and balance a smaller bust. It is lovely on Anarkalis and party wear, such as the [Lavender Taffeta Silk Gota Work Anarkali Suit Set](/products/lavender-taffeta-silk-gota-work-anarkali-suit-set-with-organza-dupatta/), where a softer neckline suits the flowing shape.

The keyhole is a small, clever detail. A front keyhole gives a hint of a V without showing much skin, and a back keyhole with tassels adds interest when your hair is tied up. Both work for most face shapes.

## Styling tips for every neckline

- **Jewellery:** Follow the neckline. A V-neck suits a pendant, a round neck suits a short necklace or just earrings, and a band collar looks best with statement earrings and no necklace.
- **Dupatta:** With a busy yoke, drape the dupatta on one shoulder so the neckline stays visible.
- **Layering:** Under a coat or cardigan, V and notched necks stay neat, while high collars can bunch up.
- **Embroidery:** Heavy embroidery near the neck adds width. Keep it lighter if you have broad shoulders.

The [Violet Nyra Cut Sequin Embroidered Cotton Suit Set](/products/violet-nyra-cut-sequin-embroidered-cotton-3-piece-suit/) is a good example of embroidery that frames the face without overpowering it.

## Can you change the neckline?

With a made-to-measure order, a small neckline adjustment, such as making it a little deeper or higher, is often possible, depending on the design and embroidery. Our [custom fit](/custom-stitched-indian-suits-made-to-measure/) page explains how we stitch to your measurements, and you can always ask before you order.

## Frequently asked questions

**Which kurta neckline suits a round face?**
V-necks, notched necks and deeper round necks are most flattering, because they add length and break up the width of the face.

**Which neckline is best for a short neck?**
A V-neck or a notched neck. Avoid very high band collars, which can make the neck look shorter.

**What neckline suits broad shoulders?**
V-necks and deeper necklines balance broad shoulders. Avoid very wide boat necks and heavy embroidery right across the yoke.

**Is a keyhole neckline modest enough for work?**
Usually yes. A small front keyhole with a tie shows very little skin and looks neat in most offices.
